title: Original-order returns and refund proposal reconciliation
description: Reconcile synthetic return requests to original receipt, line, payment and closed opening history; propose whole-unit original-price refunds with separate tax pennies and human-only review.

sample_policy.description: All identifiers are invented SYN- references and business dates are in 2099. Return windows, conditions, cumulative allocation and quarantine are configurable sample company policy, not legal advice, live availability or permission to issue money.

golden_provenance.author: Retail returns scenario owner
golden_provenance.description: The ten literal expected JSON objects were authored from the approved procedure and independent integer arithmetic before baseline implementation or execution. The manifest records each derivation; the shared pre-execution golden lock freezes inputs, answers and derivations. No expected object is produced by solving, copying baseline outputs or importing baseline logic. This declaration is not independent human sign-off.

cases.derivation: July 2, 2099; 30-day inclusive window, partial enabled. Order 1 Q3 M1000 T100, prior Q1 M333 T33. Cumulative Q2 gives M667 T67: first request receives 334+34=368; second asks2 but remaining1 receives 333+33=366 and defers1. New M667 T67 total734; prior366 plus734 equals1100, no remaining units. Order2 age31 is excluded, keeping2200. Unknown receipt remains unresolved with no assigned currency. Across USD originals: captured3300, prior366, new734, projected1100, remaining2200; two proposed units and three deferred. Three request exceptions in request order.

Different August15 period, window14, EUR original purchased August1 on the inclusive boundary; Q4 M1999 T161 capture2160. Prior1 is500+40=540. Asking2 advances cumulative quantity to3: M1499 T121, so new999+81=1080. Remaining1 carries500+40=540; prior plus new1620. Exactly one full proposal and no exceptions.

Different September10-11 period, September4 purchase, window7, partial disabled, GBP Q2 M999 T0 capture999 and explicit empty opening history. September10 request asks3, exceeding2; propose0, defer3, consume nothing. September11 request asks1 at age7; half-up 999/2=500, tax0. One unit and499 remain. One partial-not-allowed exception.
The standalone October5 bundle contains requested_qty=true, not an integer quantity. Reject at requests.requested_qty with invalid-record and no business outputs; never coerce true to one.

October6 original Q2 M1000 T100 capture1100; posted prior1 records M499 T50. Independent entitlement at1 is500+50, not499+50. Retain observed prior549, quarantine the whole order, make authoritative prior/remaining controls null, and propose zero. Currency totals explicitly exclude the one quarantined order from reconciled captured/prior/remaining money.
The October7 input includes the same request primary key twice. Structural duplicate-key rejection precedes joining or money allocation; outputs are empty, not silently deduplicated.

October8 contains two distinct original order IDs, invoice IDs and card references but the same store/receipt. Reject ambiguous-receipt before using supplied order hints to choose a winner. No proposal or control output is admissible.

October9 request for October1 purchase has age8 versus window7. Q1 M700 T70 capture770 with no prior: zero proposal and one deferred unit; valid line/order still retain one unit and770, with return-window-exceeded. This is sample policy review, not a legal-right decision.

October10 intake period also contains a posted October10 historical event. Although its Q1 M500 T50 fits original Q2 M1000 T100 mathematically, it is not an opening event. Retain observed550, quarantine the order, use null authoritative eligibility/money and zero proposal instead of subtracting or ignoring it as if disjoint.

October11 request, original Q1 M300 T30, capture/authorization330 and explicit empty history. Confirmation=false is sufficient to quarantine the entire order despite otherwise balanced arithmetic. Proposed money is0; authoritative prior/remaining are null, observed posted money0 is only a raw count-derived observation.
